notes.title: Featuring as a game character in our game
notes.content:
Would you like to transform into a [b]pixel art version of yourself[/b] and [b]become a character[/b] in Intergalactic Pawn Shop? 

If so, join our  [url=https://discord.gg/warlockarts]discord server[/url] and visit the [b]pixelArtMe [/b]channel to get involved!

We'll select 35 individuals to be featured as customers in the intergalactic pawn shop, and we'll create your pixel art version from a picture you send to us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38869514/578853ef4248e800cb2dfd8581324e20401f9add.png[/img]
